questions.q: If SCHOOL is written as NQQJEU in a certain code, how is TEMPLE written in that code?
questions.why: In the code each letter moves 2 places forward and the word is then reversed: TEMPLE → GNROGV. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: A price rises 25%, then falls 20%, then rises 10%. What is the overall increase?

questions.why: A train chugs; a door bangs (the sound each makes). GPSC CBRT, Apr 2024.

questions.q: A man walks 4 km south, turns left and walks 3 km, then turns left again and walks 8 km. How far and in which direction is he from his starting point?
questions.why: He ends 3 km east and 4 km north of the start. The straight-line distance is 5 km, to the north-east.

questions.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 18, 26, 32, 42, 50, 58, 66
questions.why: In the correct series each term adds 8, so 32 should be 34. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the pair that best represents a similar relationship: FISH : SHOAL
questions.why: A shoal is a group of fish; a pack is a group of wolves. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.

questions.q: If TEMPLE is written as GNROGV in a certain code, how is VILLAGE written in that code?
questions.why: In the code each letter moves 2 places forward and the word is then reversed: VILLAGE → GICNNKX. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Four of the following are alike in an alphabet pattern. Which one does not fit?
questions.why: 1st and 2nd letters are opposites (sum 27) and 3rd = 2nd + 3. MNP: P is N + 2. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2024.

questions.q: Today is Monday. After 61 days it will be:
questions.why: 61 = 8 weeks + 5 days; Monday + 5 = Saturday. GPSC CBRT, Feb 2024.

questions.q: In a group of 90 people, 42 like tea, 39 like coffee and 20 like neither. How many like only tea?
questions.why: Both = 42 + 39 − (90 − 20) = 11; only tea = 42 − 11 = 31. GPSC-style practice item.
